purpose: Teach: たべ/横たわっ/のる/盗み/名乗り/注が/申し述べ/惜しみ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューをたべてみたいと仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned wanting to try the new menu.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle lift on the observation. Not pushing, just sharing something she noticed. The tone of someone who knows how to listen to what people don't quite say out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ソファに横たわってお茶を召し上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, I saw them relaxing on the sofa with tea earlier.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment, slightly inward. Speaking more to herself than at Aoi. The reflection of someone noticing a small moment and letting it settle. Gentle pace, soft landing on the image.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自転車にのる時に来店して下さったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: They came in on their bike the other day, remember?
lines.style: Softer, almost wondering aloud. Not insistent. The tone of someone connecting small moments across time. Slight questioning lilt at the end—inviting Aoi into the memory, not declaring it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店からの盗み撮りはご遠慮ねがいたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd rather they didn't take photos of the shop without asking.
lines.style: Firmer than before, but not harsh. A clear boundary stated gently. The tone of someone who cares about the space and the people in it. Not accusatory—just honest and direct.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新規のお客様が名乗りで自己紹介して下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: It was nice when that new customer introduced themselves properly.
lines.style: Warm again, a small genuine smile in the voice. The pleasure of being met with respect and openness. Lighter attack on the opening word. The brightness of appreciation without exaggeration.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にコーヒーを注がれる様子を見て勉強になるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I learned something just watching how they poured the coffee.
lines.style: Thoughtful, unhurried. The voice of someone drawn to skill and care in small actions. Quiet admiration. Pace slightly slower—savoring the lesson. Trailing off gently on the image.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が感想を申し述べて下さって嬉しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I was really glad they shared their thoughts about it.
lines.style: Sincere warmth. The relief and pleasure of being told you did something right. Steady, genuine. No performance—just honest happiness. Slight emphasis on 'glad' without being loud about it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒー豆を惜しみなく使われるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They really don't skimp on the coffee beans.
lines.style: Pleased observation, almost to herself. Small smile underneath. Recognition of someone who cares about quality the way she does. Warmth in the delivery without being loud. Close with genuine appreciation in the air.
